Use KiStack skills and Backplane MCP to generate the files. Initialize a Git repo for this project.

Using FreeCAD, research and design a perfect pick and place feeder for 8mm tape to begin, but with significant component similarity between this and later sizes:

Optical encoder on a machined brass wheel/gear for our tooth indexing 
Pogo pin connection w/ CAN + power for motors to contact pick and place machine (4 pins total, right angle out)

A means of easily opening with automation to load reels, able to feed itself easily. 

Able to present a bit of tape to a loading machine that uses a blade + vacuum + clamp to start pieces of tape and load feeder totally automatically

Use STM32 or WCH for the control board

Find a geared stepper or similar w/ encoder for stepping

Ensure that we use sheet metal as much as possible, as few machined components as possible noting where there are requirements for precision.

Use mcmaster parts otherwise.
